items.html: And the example for all this: behold, the mochin of ZA, of the aspect of the Achoraim, were in his Keter, namely: Yud, Yud-Hei, Yud-Hei-Vav, Yud-Hei-Vav-Hei. And joined to them is the number of these Achoraim, which are ten letters exactly similar to them, except that they are in the aspect of the number AB (72). And afterward, at the time of the sawing, Yud, Yud-Hei, Yud-Hei-Vav, Yud-Hei-Vav-Hei remains in the aspect of letters alone, to the Keter of ZA; and Yud, Yud-Hei, Yud-Hei-Vav, Yud-Hei-Vav-Hei, in the aspect of the number, which is AB, remains in the Keter of the Nukva.
